records.text: Mason Abbas was arrested after a multi-mile police chase during which he allegedly threw 100 lottery tickets from his car.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And it tells us that he was overtaken in his automobile after a chase of several miles after he had failed to obey the officer's order to stop. ... Abbas is alleged to have thrown a package of 100 lottery tickets from his car. ... Officers recovered the tickets and are holding them as evidence.
